clauses.reason: Section 1 of EO 11262 amends section 1 of EO 11248 by adding item (4), Executive Secretary, President’s Commission on Law Enforcement and Administration of Justice, to level IV. EO 11409 (April 29, 1968) amended that item by deletion and insertion, replacing the Commission's Executive Secretary with the Administrator, National Institutes of Health, Department of Health, Education, and Welfare in the same item number (the held text has no effective-date provision; the signing date is used); under the strike-and-insert ruling this is a later amendment, the clause continued, amended, and the substance of the placement changed (note for the human reviewer). EO 11708 section 3 provides “Except with respect to the positions enumerated in section 2” and “Executive Order No. 11248 of October 10, 1965, as amended, is hereby revoked”; section 2 of EO 11708 continues only level V positions, so this level IV item was revoked on March 23, 1973 (signing date; EO 11708 has no effective-date provision). First end: express revocation of the parent order as amended.

Section 2 of EO 11262 amends section 2 of EO 11248 (level V) by adding item (4), Director, Bureau of Outdoor Recreation, Department of the Interior. No held later order deletes or retitles that item. EO 11708 section 3 provides “Except with respect to the positions enumerated in section 2” and “Executive Order No. 11248 of October 10, 1965, as amended, is hereby revoked”; the eight level V positions continued by section 2 of EO 11708 do not include the Director of the Bureau of Outdoor Recreation, so the placement was revoked on March 23, 1973 (signing date; EO 11708 has no effective-date provision). First end: express revocation of the parent order as amended.

Section 2 of EO 11262 adds item (5), Assistant to the Secretary of Defense (Legislative Affairs), to level V of EO 11248. No held later order deletes or retitles that level V item. Section 1(10) of EO 11708 places an “Assistant to the Secretary of Defense, Legislative Affairs” in level IV as a new placement under that order's own text, not as a continuation of this clause. EO 11708 section 3 provides “Except with respect to the positions enumerated in section 2” and “Executive Order No. 11248 of October 10, 1965, as amended, is hereby revoked”; the eight level V positions continued by section 2 of EO 11708 do not include this assistant, so the placement was revoked on March 23, 1973 (signing date; EO 11708 has no effective-date provision). First end: express revocation of the parent order as amended.

research_rationale:
EO 11262 (signed 1965-12-13; 30 FR 15399) was read in full in the held Federal Register text layer. Acting under subsection (f) of section 303 of the Government Employees Salary Reform Act of 1964, it further amends Executive Order No. 11248 of October 10, 1965, as amended, the order placing positions in levels IV and V of the Federal Executive Salary Schedule: section 1 adds item (4), Executive Secretary of the President's Commission on Law Enforcement and Administration of Justice, to level IV; section 2 adds item (4), Director, Bureau of Outdoor Recreation, Department of the Interior, and item (5), Assistant to the Secretary of Defense (Legislative Affairs), to level V. Each placed item is one clause; the lead and each section's introductory words are folded into the item they carry. EO 11409 (1968-04-29) deleted item (4) of section 1 and inserted a different office in the same item; under the owner's strike-and-insert ruling (2026-10-21) that is an amendment recorded as a later event and the clause continues, amended, until its parent ends (the substance of that placement changed, for the human reviewer). EO 11708 (signed 1973-03-23) section 3 revoked EO 11248 as amended except the positions enumerated in its section 2 (eight level V positions, none an item placed by this order), so all three clauses first ended on 1973-03-23 by express revocation of the parent order as amended, and the whole-order end is that date. EO 11708 section 1 places new level IV offices under its own text; that is a new command by a later order, not a continuation of this order's clause. I found no held instrument that ends any item earlier. Original not an authenticated transcription: the held text is the OCR text layer of the official Federal Register issue; quotations avoid its recognition errors.

savings.reason: EO 11262 contains no savings, transition or continuation clause. EO 11708 section 3 revokes EO 11248 as amended except the positions listed in its section 2; none of those eight level V positions is an item placed by EO 11262, so nothing of these placements was continued by that order, and a salary-level placement creates no property, fund or enforceable right that survives its removal.
